notes.title: The Away Team v2.5 Released!
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/12139385/a8771ca19d234a501a7a4db9be8036619c9ca368.png[/img]

Greetings space travellers!

Today, we are proud to finally announce that The Away Team's demo and soundtrack are now officially available. Alongside this, we are also releasing a patch that brings in a few new features.


[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/997620/The_Away_Team__Soundtrack/]The Away Team's Soundtrack[/url] is available for US$5, and includes a mix of 16 ambient and melodic tracks in FLAC format. This has been long-requested, and we're glad to get the high quality versions of the game's music tracks into fans' hands. If you're new to both or would like to gift both to a friend, we've also made the game and soundtrack available together in a [url=https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/9572/Game__Soundtrack/]bundle[/url].
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/12139385/cf5d359d5d6fdbb3ffdabf9e575353e189c10c53.png[/img]


The new Away Team: Lost Exodus demo offers prospective players the opportunity to have some first hand experience with the game before committing to the full version. Including 8 characters, two side missions, two story missions, and one set of random event missions, it's a little taste of everything. If you've been trying to work out whether The Away Team is for you, or haven't quite found the right way to recommend it to a friend, the demo lets you do that hassle free. The demo can be installed from the [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/426290/The_Away_Team_Lost_Exodus/]Steam store page[/url], and any progress made in the demo will carry across to the full version of the game.
[url=https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/12139385/4c2e0aa4f12934a863755a0a9fab684ddbcb0717.png][img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/12139385/e149857600d027645f519db320883ae10341e1e8.png[/img][/url]


Last, but certainly not least, we have released the 2.5 update to the game itself. This is not a large patch, but it does contain a number of small additions that we hope will make players' experiences more enjoyable.
[list]
[*] Added in-game "Challenges" screen for viewing achievements and achievement progress
[*] Added a clock/time counter to the sector screen
[*] Added two "Cheats" that allow players to modify gameplay to suit personal preferences
[*] Added tooltips for food, fuel and time in the sector screen
[/list]
[url=https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/12139385/5fbd3508c0eec8867b4997585f4a53ce1eab31b6.png][img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/12139385/ee1ae833abe24a00af405abe5cfce58c00e9f915.png[/img][/url] [url=https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/12139385/8f255d9fc07037d3fbe8f9cf25947ae2f91cd9f3.png][img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/12139385/430aca78ed7bdd6a503aaffe16988690d5187730.png[/img][/url] [url=https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/12139385/b5edfaf8e8006a2bbdfb69e1ff430f8ea92239a4.png][img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/12139385/bf9de87575b8e1372a00f7af2cf1d975fe0993af.png[/img][/url] [url=https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/12139385/13ae7f2f8da970ccb900fea1445172c048e3a8c8.png][img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/12139385/4fcc257f2b3141d856cff88641b862e1ebaece3e.png[/img][/url]

For a full list of changes and fixes, see our [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/426290/discussions/0/1734342793784839163/]Patch Notes[/url] thread.


Enjoy!

notes.title: Lost Exodus update is now live!
notes.content:
Greetings, space travellers!

It is with great pleasure that we announce that The Away Team's Lost Exodus update is out and available to play right now!

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=t12HtZWVxxQ

In addition to bugfixes, stability improvements and good old typo corrections, the Lost Exodus update includes:
[list]
[*] Expanded story, increasing the game's mission content to over 120,000 words
[*] Enhanced sector exploration with new ship handling, random event missions and asteroid fields
[*] Fancy new ship graphics
[*] A new crew role experience system
[*] A new unlockable character with their own story arc to explore
[*] Over 50 “memento” items for crewmembers to collect
[*] 11 new Steam achivements
[*] A new character editor with Steam Workshop integration
[*] Improved sprite rendering
[*] Clearer text and an optional dyslexic-friendly font
[/list]
You can find changelogs for this and future updates in the new [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/426290/discussions/0/1734342793784839163/]patch notes[/url] thread.


Some things you might be interested in checking out before you play:

We partnered with long-time fan Jason Silverain to put together an introduction to the new in-game character editor.

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=tYM-o-MaG4M

Some of our wonderful testers also uploaded their own characters to [url=https://steamcommunity.com/workshop/browse/?appid=426290]the new Steam Workshop page[/url] for you to take with you on your adventures across the universe.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/12139385/b44d4101f8addf1bcf72fc4b6a29e56529d9e2da.png[/img]


We're publishing write-ups that delve into the kind of effort we put into the Lost Exodus update on the Underflow blog, in [url=https://underflowstudios.com/the-away-team-lost-exodus-redesigning-the-argo/]this post[/url], we take a look at the process behind expanding and refining the design of the Argo.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/12139385/75fdb50d36fad3b400da1aa4dfe2f175fa8d22f2.png[/img]


Lastly, we'd like to extend a thank you to everyone who has been patient as we put this update together, and an extra big thanks to those who helped us test the game and make sure it was ready to come out of the oven.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/12139385/a9ea3b3d8bfcd052d541fd1ce74ade85f05cebbd.png[/img]

Enjoy!

notes.title: Lost Exodus update to release the 22nd, along with a price change!
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/12139385/a4c3293209b89dad94f36d21bed76092c68f48a9.png[/img]

Greetings, space travellers!

We are proud to announce that The Away Team's upcoming update, Lost Exodus, will be launching on Steam and Itch.io on October 22nd!

https://youtu.be/AZqXnaq4PAo

Lost Exodus polishes and builds upon The Away Team's core choose-your-own- adventure and real-time space exploration experiences by adding more content, improved gameplay, and an in-game character with integrated Steam Workshop support.

There are a lot of changes to go over, and we'll be digging in in more detail with a proper changes, but for now, here's a rundown on the key stuff:
[list]
    [*]Expanded story, increasing the game's mission content to over 120,000 words
    [*]Enhanced sector exploration with new random event missions and asteroid fields
    [*]A new crew role experience system
    [*]A new unlockable character with their own story arc to explore
    [*]Over 50 “memento” items for crewmembers to collect
    [*]A new character editor with Steam Workshop integration
    [*]Improved sprite rendering
    [*]Clearer text and an optional dyslexic-friendly font
[/list]

Additionally we are announcing today that the game’s base price will be increasing to $8.00 to coincide with the update’s release. A lot of effort, talent, and love has gone into making both the original game and this update, and w feel strongly that the new price of $8 will better reflect and honor that. If you'd prefer to get in early and pick up The Away Team or gift it to a friend at the lower price of $2.00, we understand.

We are really looking forward to sharing what we've been working on with new and existing players on the 22nd, and hope you'll celebrate with us by checking it out :)

If you'd like to check out some screenshots of the new bits and pieces ahead of us updating the store page, you can check out our presskit here: http://press.underflowstudios.com/sheet.php?p=The_Away_Team​

notes.title: Coming Soon: Lost Exodus
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/12139385/8934dc45e3446b0f0dcf0bdc53a9b5563b1dad66.png[/img]
Hi everybody! We are very excited to to let you all know we have been hard at work on a large update that rounds out The Away Team while keeping the core game that you (hopefully) know and love.

The big features we have been working on for the Lost Exodus update include:
[list]
[*] New adventures to explore
[*] New in-game character creator (with offline support for sharing as well as Steam Workshop integration)
[*] New gameplay features focusing on searching and survival
[*] More ways to track current status and progress
[*] UX improvements
[*] Many bug fixes!
[/list]

We're not quite ready to talk about dates, but we are excited to share what we've been working on with players, and we're working hard to get it into people's hands as soon as its ready!

The small update that went out today includes some small changes in preparation for the Lost Exodus update, but nothing that is visible to users except an updated background for the main menu. 

Thanks,
Michael Brune

- New in-game character creator (with offline support for sharing as well as Steam Workshop integration)
- New gameplay features focusing on searching and survival
- More ways to track current status and progress
- UX improvements
